newsitem.title: YEMEN: United States grants Yemen $5 million soft loan.
newsitem.headline: United States grants Yemen $5 million soft loan.

text.p: The United States on Monday signed a memorandum of understanding with Yemen approving a $5 million soft loan for a series of development projects, an official at Yemen's ministry of planning and development said.

"(An agreement of understanding) between Yemen and the U.S. government was signed today (Monday) according to which about 500 million Yemeni rials ($5 million) will be allocated for the implementation of a number of projects," he told Reuters.
He said the agreement came within the framework of the U.S. commodities soft loans programme.
The official said the money would be used in development and agricultural projects and to promote environmental protection. ($1=100 Yemeni rials)
